issues.on_page: Cash and Equity in Pooled Investment Account 48,789,081 + Cash at County Treasurer 864,949 (Total Governmental Funds); no single printed cash total
issues.issue: ending_cash is a sum the extractor computed (marked computed, arithmetic correct). The 2026-11-06 ruling says cash is filled only where printed and never derived, and beginning cash is null, so this one-sided figure may not belong in ending_cash.
